name: qa_usbrec
title: OS-USBRECQA, row QA-REC-034 of docs/qa/catalogue/record.md: Sample Rec with SOURCE = USB records the computer's tone (o3tone.py plays 1 kHz, -12 dBFS, started by hand first): the level going into the take on the IN meters, the take played back over the USB AUDIO capture at its pitch; nothing is saved

steps.say: OS-USBRECQA, row QA-REC-034 (docs/qa/catalogue/record.md): Sample Rec with SOURCE = USB records what the computer plays into the unit over USB AUDIO, at its level and its pitch. SEMI-AUTOMATIC: o3hil has no step that plays audio, so START THE TONE FIRST, in a second terminal, and leave it running: `python3 -I platform/mk66/tools/o3tone.py play` (1 kHz, -12 dBFS, both channels, 300 s; it finds the unit's playback device by name; `o3tone.py list` shows what it found). The scenario then needs the USB AUDIO device (the unit in `usb mode audio`, USB AUDIO and USB RETURN On in Config, profile 8 with the return: the scenario sets `usb profile 8 duplex` itself ('8 OUT / 2 IN'; the default '8 OUT' has no return and o3tone finds no playback device) and puts `usb profile 8 out` back at the end; start the tone AFTER the scenario has set it, or restart it if it found no device: the capture channel of MASTER L is 7; with another profile pass --var CH=<n> --var CHANNELS=<count>; with another tone pass --var HZ=<hz> and the same --hz to o3tone). It writes nothing to the card: the take stays in the sample memory and is discarded at the end.

steps.note: precondition: the unit presents USB AUDIO (the return stream needs it)

steps.expect: usb: (already presenting AUDIO with that layout|re-enumerating as \w+)
steps.note: profile 8 WITH the stereo return ("8 OUT / 2 IN"): the default profile 8 is "8 OUT" (capture only), so o3tone finds no playback device. Both answers are fine: `already presenting` when the layout is already set, `re-enumerating` when it changes; a re-enumeration drops the console and o3tone for a moment (the next step waits for the device)
(the USB device is presented again with the new layout: the computer needs a moment before o3tone sees the playback device)
(a leftover overlay is put away: F8 is Back)
the monitor off: the input is not sent to MAIN, so the capture below can only hold what the take plays
the SOURCES page
the cursor on the first row, SOURCE
SOURCE: LINE, LINE L, LINE R, MIC LG, MIC HG, RADIO, USB: the encoder stops at the last, USB, however far the burst goes
(the input settles for 200 ms after a change of source: F1 would say THE SOURCE IS SETTLING)
QA-REC-034: SOURCE reads USB and GAIN reads -- (the simulator has no recorder: no picture to compare with, look at it)

QA-REC-034, the LEVEL going into the take: the input strip carries the USB return at unity: a -12 dBFS sine reads about -15 dBFS rms and -12 dBFS peak on both IN meters (3 dB either way). A failure here is the tone not arriving: is `o3tone.py play` running, USB RETURN On in Config > USB, the unit's playback device the one it found?
F1 arms the take: the transport is stopped, so it starts at once (ALIGN is FREE while stopped)
about 3.5 s of the tone go into the take
(the take is drawn as it records)
F1 ends the take (STOP AT is MANUAL): it is under review
(soft: under review the 48 pads play the take, so they are lit; the capture below is the real proof of a take)
QA-REC-034: TAKE: TRIM, THEN SAVE, a waveform of the length that was recorded
QA-REC-034, before the pad: MASTER L is silent while the tone still plays into the unit (the return is in no capture), so the pitch below is the take's
the pad at the take's own pitch (C-4, record_view.h rec_pad_note), held: the take plays through its trim window

QA-REC-034, the TAKE: MASTER L plays the recorded tone at the pitch it was played at (40 cents either way), not silent and not clipped. The level here is the take through the pad, track and master (not asked to be exact: the level going in is the `mix` step above); a failure line shows the pitch and level that were heard
F4 throws the take away: nothing is saved, the instrument slots are as they were

finally.note: (a take left under review is thrown away; with none, F4 does nothing)
(SOURCE back to its default, LINE: the cursor is still on the SOURCE row)
(a leftover overlay is put away: F8 is Back)
back to the default profile 8 (capture only)
